name: returning_customer_reference_past_interaction
description: Returning customer asks 'Remember me? We spoke earlier' and the AI should reference the past interaction, confirming it recalls the earlier conversation.

messages.text: My name is Priya, can I get a quote for 30 sheets of oak melamine chipboard 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: AI should address the customer as 'Priya' and reference the earlier conversation

notes: Tests explicit recall: the customer challenges the AI to remember them. The AI should confirm it recalls the earlier interaction, ideally mentioning the product (oak melamine chipboard) that was discussed.
